answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ferrous of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A nebula of per-task receipts records who did what, and the yarrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
